answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the sonnet check immediately, the ember audit keeps the resolved set and the haven replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 291 aliases hence forfeits the reading cost 291 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
